rules.title: Smart Rules
rules.intro: Write a rule once, the whole shop follows it — product pages, bag, checkout, SMS and the AI answers.

empty.topic: No rules in this topic yet.
empty.none: No rules yet. Start with the starter rules — they come in as drafts with empty values, so nothing reaches customers until the values are filled in and the owner switches them on.
empty.pick: Pick a rule on the left to change it.

editor.aiOff: The AI helper is off for this shop.
editor.aiMock: The AI writing help is not connected yet.
editor.aiHint: AI off? Fill these fields yourself — the rule works exactly the same.
editor.name: Title
editor.shortHint: · shown next to Add to Bag, in the bag and at checkout
editor.countTitle: Characters customers see, with the values filled in

tokens.none: No {placeholders} in this rule — the text is used exactly as written.
tokens.paramUnset: {token} is replaced by “{label}” — not set yet
tokens.window: {token} is this rule's own date — now {value}
tokens.windowUnset: {token} is this rule's own date — not set yet
tokens.runtime: {token} is filled in by the shop at the moment it is shown
tokens.unknown: {token} names nothing — add a value or take it out of the text

editor.settingsHint: · the values the text and the rule use
editor.noSettings: This rule has no values to set.
editor.paramHint: Change this value and the shop updates by itself. Customers see: “{text}”
editor.notSet: Not set yet — the owner decides
editor.openEnd: Leave empty to run until it is switched off. Times are in {zone}.
editor.priorityHint: When two rules want the same thing, the higher number wins.
editor.stackable: Can be combined with other discounts
editor.noActions: Text only — this rule changes no price or charge.

actions.deliveryCharge: Sets the delivery charge per area
actions.exchangePolicy: Sets the exchange window, what qualifies and who pays
actions.setTier: Any few pieces for a set price
actions.cod: Cash on delivery on or off

editor.published: Published v{version}. The shop now uses this rule.
editor.saved: Draft saved — customers see nothing of it yet.
editor.draftThrown: The saved draft was thrown away
editor.archived: Archived — it is kept with its history and can be brought back.
editor.ownerOkNote: This rule changes money (a price, a charge, a discount or cash on delivery). Switching it on, and every change to its money while it is on, needs the owner's OK.
editor.ownerOkWait: Saved as a draft. Someone with the owner's OK has to publish it.
editor.archivedNote: This rule is archived. Bring it back to change it.
editor.brokenNote: This rule's stored version cannot be read. Bring back an older version from its history.
editor.readOnly: You can look at the rules; changing them needs the "change rules" permission.

issues.UNKNOWN_PARAM: An action uses a value the rule does not have ({subject})
issues.WRONG_PARAM_TYPE: An action needs another kind of value ({subject})
issues.ACTION_NOT_ALLOWED: This topic cannot use that action ({subject})
issues.SLOT_NOT_ALLOWED: This topic has no such text ({subject})
issues.NO_TEXT: The short version is not written
issues.PERCENT_TOO_HIGH: The percentage is above the shop's limit
issues.UNKNOWN_PLACEMENT: “{subject}” is not one of the shop's places
issues.HAND_WRITTEN_NUMBER: “{subject}” is written by hand — use the value's placeholder so the text follows the rule

preview.title: Preview — {name}
preview.intro: When you publish, these places update by themselves:
preview.noPlaces: No place shows this rule's text.
preview.notLive: Status is Draft — customers will not see this rule until it is set to Active.
preview.quotedBy: These texts quote this rule and change with it:
preview.canApprove: You can give it: publishing now counts as the owner's OK.
preview.cannotApprove: You cannot give it: save the draft, and someone with the owner's OK publishes it.
preview.conflicts: Clashes with other rules once live: {n}. They show in the banner after publishing.
preview.noChanges: No changes yet — edit the text or values to see the difference.

history.title: History — {name}
history.intro: Every published version is kept. Bringing one back makes it the draft; publish it to use it.
history.unreadable: This version cannot be read any more.
history.broughtBack: v{version} is back as the draft — preview and publish it to use it.

simulate.title: Try on past orders — {name}
simulate.intro: Prices the orders of the last days again with this version of the rule and compares. Nothing is charged or changed.
simulate.capped: Only the latest {n} — the limit is in settings.
simulate.codRefused: Orders where cash on delivery is refused
simulate.unknown: Orders whose delivery charge cannot be told (no area, or a charge not set yet): {n}

coupons.title: Coupons — {name}
coupons.intro: A coupon unlocks this discount. It starts switched off; switching it on needs the owner's OK.

aud.FIRST_ORDER: First order only (checked by phone number)

coupons.added: Coupon added — it stays off until it is switched on
coupons.needsCoupon: Coupons work only with a discount that asks for a coupon.

conflicts.title: Conflict found
conflicts.fixed: Fixed everywhere — {n} text(s) now quote the rule

kinds.SAME_SLOT: “{a}” and “{b}” both set {slot}. “{winner}” wins by the order (priority, then the narrower rule, then the newer).
kinds.STACKING: “{a}” and “{b}” are both discounts that may not be combined. “{winner}” wins.
kinds.SETTING_DRIFT: The setting “{setting}” says {settingValue}; the rule “{a}” says {ruleValue}. The rule is what the shop uses.

newRule.title: New rule
newRule.name: Title
newRule.shortPlaceholder: One line customers see next to Add to Bag
newRule.fullPlaceholder: Write it the way you would explain it to a customer. Use {placeholders} for numbers.
newRule.ai: Paste your policy in “Full rule” — the AI helper can write the short version once it is connected.
newRule.nameNeeded: Please give the rule a title
newRule.moneyNote: This rule moves money: it starts as a draft and needs the owner's OK to go live.

scope.introExcept: Which items should NOT follow this rule?

errors.NOT_FOUND: This was not found — reload the page.
errors.CONFLICT: Someone else changed this at the same time — reload the page.
errors.KEY_TAKEN: That short name is taken — choose another title.
errors.RULE_INCOMPLETE: It cannot go live yet — fix the points listed under the rule.
errors.OWNER_OK_REQUIRED: This changes money and needs the owner's OK. Someone with the owner's OK has to do it.
errors.RULE_ACTIVE: Switch the rule to Draft and publish before archiving it.
errors.RULE_ARCHIVED: This rule is archived. Bring it back first.
errors.NOTHING_TO_PUBLISH: There is nothing new to publish.
errors.STALE_DRAFT: Someone published this rule since you opened it. Reload the page to see the new version.
errors.KEY_FIXED: The topic and the short name of a rule stay as they are.
errors.COUPON_RULE_INVALID: Coupons work only with a discount that asks for a coupon.
errors.CANNOT_FIX: This clash cannot be fixed by itself — change the text by hand.

notices.title: Notices & pop-ups
notices.intro: Bars, banners and pop-ups. Their text can quote a rule — like {exchange.windowHours} — so a number is never written twice.
notices.standing: Pop-ups never open on arrival: they wait some seconds, a scroll, the visitor leaving, or a tap. A phone visitor from a search engine never gets one on the first screen, and every pop-up has a limit on how often it shows.
notices.pick: Pick a notice to change it.

fields.keyHelp: Lower-case words joined by -, e.g. eid-delivery
fields.name: Name (only you see it)
fields.ctaHref: Button goes to (a path in the shop, like /sale)
fields.clickKey: Name of the button that opens it
fields.rule: Belongs to the rule (shows only while that rule is live)

issues.ARRIVAL_POPUP: A pop-up may not open on arrival — give it a delay or a scroll.
issues.DELAY_TOO_SHORT: The delay is shorter than the shop allows.
issues.SCROLL_TOO_SHORT: The scroll is shorter than the shop allows.
issues.NO_CAP: A pop-up needs a limit on how often it shows.
issues.TIMING_NOT_FOR_KIND: Only a pop-up has an opening time.
issues.UNKNOWN_PLACEMENT: A place is not in the shop's list.
issues.CLICK_KEY_MISSING: Give the name of the button that opens it.
issues.MISSING_VALUE: A value the text quotes is not set yet.
issues.UNKNOWN_TOKEN: The text quotes something that does not exist.

notices.created: Notice added — it stays off until it is switched on
